snippet.title: Super Speed Race Arcade
snippet.description:
The game is a one player racing video game where players controls a race car along a constantly scrolling vertical road. 
The player must again use a steering wheel and gear shifter to take up control of a car, with a single pedal to make it accelerate and if the car crashes into a CPU-controlled car or goes off the track it will be sent back to the start. You will now also have to watch out for patches of ice and oil slicks on the track. 

The objective of the game is to drive past other cars that scroll past the players under a 80 second time limit without colliding into them. 
Points are earned by driving past cars, with additional points being awarded based on how fast the car is moving. 
The game ends when the time limit runs out, though the timer can be extended by earning a certain number of points.
